title: Funding Operations Schedule: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Funding Window and Relationship Exposure Cap
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — funding schedule by tier.**

Two figures govern whether a dealer's contract package for the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract can be funded: the funding window, in calendar days after the contract date, within which the dealer must deliver a complete contract package; and the relationship exposure cap, the maximum combined Kestrel consumer exposure of the customer, in USD, including the contract being booked.

| Tier | Funding window (calendar days after the contract date) | Relationship exposure cap (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 30 | 45,000.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 30 | 60,000.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 30 | 85,000.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 30 | 110,000.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 30 | 150,000.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 30 | 200,000.00 |

In plain figures, the caps from Tier 5 to Tier 1+ are 45000, 60000, 85000, 110000, 150000 and 200000 dollars. The cap that applies is the cap of the tier being booked.

## Notes on the figures

- The funding window is the same 30 calendar days on every tier.
- The cap is a ceiling on the combined exposure: a combined figure equal to the cap is within it; one cent above it is not.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Tier 3 booking whose combined exposure, the new amount financed included, comes to 84,999.00 dollars is within the 85,000.00 dollar Tier 3 cap; the same combined figure on a Tier 5 booking exceeds the 45,000.00 dollar Tier 5 cap.
